Hey Julius, 

Hope you’re doing well! I caught your recent talk on innovation trends and thought it was fantastic. How did it impact your work and any upcoming projects? We’re evaluating solutions for our Security Awareness Training program here at Auriga Retail Group, and any insights you might share would be great. 

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts!

-Markus

events.reply: Hey Markus, thanks, nice of you! Which talk did you catch? Happy to chat if there's a real evaluation behind this. What's your role at Auriga, how many employees are in scope and when do you want to decide? The best way in is a demo request via revel8.ai, and the team will pick it up on Monday.
